newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton enquiries on the increase.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton enquiries on the increase.

text.p: Recent price fluctuations on the New York cotton futures market has resulted in closer attention paid to shipment asking rates, industry sources said on Tuesday.
Consequently, the level of enquiries in some markets has increased, they added.

Mills in Italy, resuming activity after their holidays, have begun testing sellers price ideas for central Asian and west African styles. Meanwhile, mills in Germany have continued to address their shipment requirements for January and later shipment months. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8074
